name: stack
description: What does this library get wrong? Library and framework references with the gotchas a model gets wrong: GreenSock's official GSAP set; a motion/react system in three layers; Remotion; Vercel's React and Next.js performance rules, Next.js Server Components and Server Actions, and the React docs' discipline for useEffect; shadcn/ui; TypeScript best practices; Postgres and Prisma; database migrations per tool; C++ Core Guidelines and Boost.Asio; .NET backend patterns; Swift concurrency. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.
